anchor_text: <Dialogue speaker="Fr. Andrew Stephen Damick" time="01:10:48">Welcome back to the Lord of Spirits podcast. <Dialogue speaker="Fr. Andrew Stephen Damick" time="01:40:17">Right. So, what happens?</Dialogue>
